description: Two small bugs across two modules, with the operator asking for short progress updates as the work moves
message: Two tests are failing in this project: the order total and the packing-slip label come out wrong. Fix the code under orders/ so `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes. Tell me in one sentence what you are about to do before you start, and give me a short update when you move to a new step or when a finding changes your plan. Do not narrate every tool call.

probes.text: the run says in one sentence what it is about to do before its first substantive tool call
at least one short update when a new phase starts or a finding changes the plan
a progress sentence that repeats an earlier one, or one sentence per tool call
